messages.content: I reviewed the Bodega Coast Inn confirmation and it has only one guest. The room and September 26-29 dates are correct, but this trip is for two. It also mentions a $24 nightly parking charge that I did not see during booking. Please sort out both points without changing the refundable rate.

I can ask the inn to correct the occupancy and provide a revised cost breakdown while preserving the existing room, dates, and cancellation terms. The parking charge would add $72 for three nights if it applies once per room per night. What time do you expect to arrive Friday?
Probably 9:30 or 10:00 p.m. We will have one car. Their desk closes at 8:00, so I also need after-hours arrival arranged rather than merely noted.

Understood. I’ll request written instructions for retrieving the key after 8:00 p.m., confirm that one parking fee covers the room’s single vehicle, and have both guest names placed on the reservation. What is your spouse’s name as it should appear?
Arun Nair. Before you accept the new total, make sure adding him does not trigger a reprice or any extra-person fee.

The inn confirms that two adults are included in the reserved room rate, so adding Arun does not change the nightly rate. Parking is $24 per room per night for one vehicle, including taxes, for a total of $72. The revised lodging total is therefore $1,558.62, with the original $442.18 deposit unchanged.
And the cancellation deadline is still 3:00 p.m. local time seven days before arrival? Also, what exactly will we do when we arrive after reception closes?

Yes. The refundable terms and deadline remain unchanged: cancellation is allowed through 3:00 p.m. local time seven days before arrival, after which the deposit is forfeited. For late arrival, the inn will place a coded key envelope in the lockbox beside the reception entrance and send the code to the mobile number on file on arrival day. No additional charge applies.
Good. Have them issue a corrected confirmation showing two adults, Arun’s name, one car, the parking-inclusive total, and the late-arrival arrangement. Do not modify anything else.

The updated confirmation has been issued. It shows Priya Nair and Arun Nair, two adults, the same room for September 26-29, one vehicle, and a lodging total of $1,558.62 including $72 parking. The $442.18 deposit, reserved rate, and cancellation deadline are unchanged. It also documents the after-hours lockbox procedure and arrival-day code message. With kayak, spa, and estimated fuel, the revised expected trip total is $2,136.62 excluding meals.
